claims.claim: Added bounded Human-facing CLI command 'aios performance <TASK_ID> [<TASK_ID> ...]' with optional '--repo' returning structured JSON AIOS_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVATION v1 without state mutation or daemon dependencies.

Implemented selector validation for 1-32 TASK IDs, rejecting malformed and duplicate selectors, and enforcing fail-closed bounds on >256 terminal RUNs and competing terminal kinds across upstream namespaces.

Implemented canonical observation binding validation against run.json and terminal documents, failing closed on mismatch or corruption while treating missing observation.json as an explicit coverage gap.

Implemented deterministic aggregation formulas including exact nearest-rank duration percentiles (ceil(p*n/100)), failure rate, verification share, token counters, and soft-budget counts without fabricating historical classifications.
Implemented coverage summary reporting terminal run counts, observed/unobserved runs, and coverage ratio across terminal runs.
Implemented null semantics for empty samples returning null for percentiles, failure rate, verification share, and token totals.
Enforced strict read-only transport resolution without mutating local refs, worktrees, or caching local state.
Structured performance observation logic cleanly across review_transport, performance_observation, and operator modules with comprehensive test coverage.
